'This gets +1{d} while defending a weapon attack. / Guardwell'

Identical text to blade_beckoner_boots (Legs printing); same shape, copied from shipped pen/basalt_boots.json.

Guardwell is a printed keyword (printed_keywords) and fires from the card DB keywords field (ability_keywords.guardwell) - deliberately NOT authored here; authoring it again would be a defect.

The +1{d} clause: WHILE_STATIC naming trigger RECALC_DEFENSE + MODIFY_DEFENSE. engine._recalculate_total_defense (engine.py:1983-2054) resets each declared defender to its base {d}, then dispatches RECALC_DEFENSE once per defender to [that defender] + the attack card + both heroes + all permanents/head/chest/arms/legs/weapon zones of BOTH players (engine.py:2016-2031) - head is in that list, so this equipment receives the dispatch when it defends. Naming the trigger matters: without it the static defaults to RECALC_ATTACK_POWER, where combat.defense_recalc_card is None and MODIFY_DEFENSE falls back to its source card (interpreter.py:186-201).

IS_DEFENDING_CARD scopes the effect to the defender currently being evaluated (combat.defense_recalc_card is this card, condition_types.py:536-599); without it the once-per-defender dispatch would let this static add +1{d} to every other defending card in turn. MODIFY_DEFENSE writes the defender card's own {d} (effect_types.py:2614-2650), which survives into total_defense; because each pass resets to base first, the static cannot stack across recalculations.

ATTACK_IS_WEAPON reads combat.from_weapon (condition_types.py:198-199), stamped from attack_card.is_weapon when the CombatState is created (engine.py:527) and consulted at defense-recalc time. That is exactly the release note's reading: the check is on the CURRENT attack being a weapon attack, not on the weapon still sitting on this chain link - so the +1{d} holds even if the weapon has since been used on another link or flicked.
